existing_knowledge_review.positive: Source shows repeated address derivation; inspect generated code and same-core scalar time.
existing_knowledge_review.counterexample: High scalar ratio in a tiny core duration does not establish material runtime cost.
existing_knowledge_review.inapplicable: Without matching generated code, do not assert that source arithmetic survived compilation.

existing_knowledge_review.positive: Same addresses are reloaded across tiles; test reuse and inspect same-scope volume.
existing_knowledge_review.counterexample: Necessary volume with fine-grained transfers suggests a different experiment than reuse.
existing_knowledge_review.inapplicable: No reusable locality or already reused data; double buffering is not required.

existing_knowledge_review.positive: Operand layout supports a conflict hypothesis; test a reversible stride/padding variant.
existing_knowledge_review.counterexample: Lower conflict ratio with slower natural timing is not a successful optimization.
existing_knowledge_review.inapplicable: Padding exceeds the peak live-allocation budget or alters transfer cost unaccounted for.

existing_knowledge_review.positive: Vector-only source has unintended MIX startup; verify compiled type and test legal launch alternatives.
existing_knowledge_review.counterexample: More balanced or more numerous cores need not be faster.
existing_knowledge_review.inapplicable: A mixed dependency requires both AIC and AIV; do not remove a necessary component.
